free_tier.stated: Free: 3 GB per transfer AND 10 transfers per rolling 30-day window (a pool, not per-send). Links live up to 3 days. Starter 10 transfers/300 GB. Ultimate unlimited transfers up to 1 TB/transfer.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

tooling: Paid API; no usable free API. The useful artefact here is the help-centre plan-limits page, which states the pool semantics precisely.
chaining: 3 GB x 10 transfers per 30 days = 30 GB/month per account, at 3-day retention. This is the weakest unit in the niche and the reason the whole category exists.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 3 GB free. Retention: 3 days free. request-rate effectively 10 transfers/30 days rolling. Storage (2 TB default) is an account-level concept that does not apply to free transfers.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: The pricing page is JS-walled and returns 'Uh-oh.. We couldn't load some important parts of our website' through both read and the Wayback capture. The help-centre article is the only reliable source. 3 GB AND 10-per-30-days both apply; the pool is missed by most comparisons.
